spans.s: Pleased, delighted, glad, happy, rejoiced, enraptured.
] An organ of sense; न मे हृषीकाणि पतन्त्यसत्पथे
. -Comp. -ईशः an epithet of Viṣṇu; or Kṛiṣṇa; पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनंजयः (दध्मौ)
; et. seq. (हृषीकाणीन्द्रियाण्याहुस्तेषामीशो यतो भवान् । हृषीकेशस्ततो विष्णो ख्यातो देवेषु केशव ॥ Mb.)
हृष् [hṛṣ], 1, 4 P. (हर्षति, हृष्यति, हृष्ट or हृषित)
To be delighted or rejoiced, be pleased or glad, to exult, rejoice; अद्विदीयं रुचात्मानं मत्वा किं चन्द्र हृष्यसि
To bristle or stand erect, stand on end (as the hair of the body); सुखवेदनाहृषितरोमकूपया Śi.13. 13; हृषितास्तनूरुहाः Dk.; हृष्यन्ति रोमकूपानि Mb.
To become erect (said of other things, e. g. the penis).
To lie, tell a lie. -Caus. (हर्षयति-ते) To please, delight, fill with pleasure.

Surprised. -Comp. चित्त, -मानस a. rejoiced in mind, glad at heart, happy. -तनु, -तनूरुह, -रोमन् a. having the hair on the body bristling or thrilling (with joy). -रूप a. in a happy mood. -वदनa. having a cheerful countenance. -संकल्पः a. contented, pleased. -हृदय a. joyous-hearted, cheerful, merry.
Delight, happiness, joy, pleasure; वस्ताण्डवं देवि भूयादभीष्ट्यै च हृष्ट्यै च नः
Knowledge. -Comp. -योनिः a kind of semiimpotent man.
